Rating Knowledge Exam & Billet-Based Advancement

The Rating Knowledge Exam (RKE) assesses rating knowledge for Sailors in applicable Billet-Based Advancement (BBA) ratings and paygrades.

How Billet-Based Advancement works

BBA links advancement to filling a qualifying position. Through Advance to Position (A2P), eligible Sailors compete for billets and advance upon reporting to the selected assignment. Command Advance to Position (CA2P) allows eligible Sailors to advance into an authorized vacancy through their command, subject to program requirements.

RKE/BBA applies to designated ratings and paygrades; others continue under the applicable Navy-wide Advancement Exam process. Navy advancement checklist · BBA guidance
